faqs.q: Q: Can we see Mt. Everest from Nagarkot?
faqs.a: Yes! On clear days (especially Oct-Nov & Mar-Apr), Mt. Everest is visible as a white peak on the eastern horizon.

tour/nepal-luxury-helicopter-tour/index..title: Nepal Everest & Annapurna Luxury Helicopter Sightseeing Tour

faqs.q: Q: Do we land at Everest Base Camp / Kala Patthar?
faqs.a: Yes! Weather permitting, the helicopter lands at Kala Patthar (5,545m) for 10-15 minutes for photo opportunities.

faqs.q: Q: Is oxygen available on board the helicopter?
faqs.a: Yes, emergency medical oxygen cylinders are equipped in all our helicopters for high-altitude comfort.

faqs.q: Q: What time does the 1-day city tour begin and end?
faqs.a: The tour typically departs at 08:30 AM from your hotel lobby and concludes around 05:00 PM – 05:30 PM. Since this is a private tour, you may request an earlier or slightly later morning departure time to fit your flight or personal schedule.

faqs.q: Q: Where do you pick us up from?
faqs.a: We provide complimentary door-to-door pick-up and drop-off from any hotel, guesthouse, or apartment located within Kathmandu city, Thamel, Lazimpat, or Patan. If your hotel is located outside the city rim (e.g. Nagarkot or Dhulikhel), transfer can be arranged for a modest surcharge.

faqs.q: Q: Are monument entrance fees included or payable on the spot?
faqs.a: Entrance tickets to heritage monuments are paid directly at official ticket booths (approximately NPR 2,600 / ~$20 USD total across all 4 sites). SAARC nationals receive deeply discounted rates. Your guide will assist you at each booth to ensure seamless ticket issuance. If you prefer an all-inclusive package with tickets prepaid, we can easily add this upon request.

faqs.q: Q: What should I wear when visiting temples and stupas?
faqs.a: Please dress respectfully when visiting sacred places of worship in Nepal. Shoulders and knees should be covered. Wear comfortable walking shoes that are easy to slip on and off, as footwear must be removed before entering monastery prayer rooms and Hindu temple courtyards.

faqs.q: Q: Can we customize the sites we visit during the day?
faqs.a: Yes! Because this is a 100% private tour, the itinerary is completely flexible. If you have already visited Swayambhunath or wish to substitute Patan Durbar Square or Bhaktapur, simply let your guide or trip planner know in advance, and we will tailor the route accordingly.

faqs.q: Q: Is this tour suitable for families with children or seniors?
faqs.a: Absolutely. The tour is paced gently with minimal strenuous walking. At Swayambhunath, our private car can drive up to the rear western parking lot to bypass the 365 steep steps for seniors or guests with knee concerns.

faqs.q: Q: Can we take a domestic flight to Pokhara instead of driving?

faqs.q: Q: Is Sarangkot sunrise trip early in the morning?
faqs.a: Yes, we depart hotel around 5:00 AM to catch the golden morning light over the Annapurna peak range.

faqs.q: Q: Is boating on Phewa Lake safe?
faqs.a: Yes, all boats are equipped with life jackets and guided by professional local boatmen.
